digest.component_or_area: LLM runner structured output and retry logic
propositions: All structured-output consumers must route through a single PydanticAIRunner facade with one-operation path, verified by mode-resolving AST census covering src/ and scripts/
The structured_retry_limit parameter is retained as the output-retry-allowance cap, seeding both Agent retries and request-budget addend via output_retry_allowance()
A well-formed first response yields exactly one outer agent.run_sync invocation; the bug-895c downgrade triggers exactly two (native then prompted), never more
structured_retry_limit=0 produces zero output-repair retries (single-shot fail-safe), preserving overlap/judge.py:212 and contracts.py:223 batch abstain behavior
Bespoke fresh-Agent output-attempt loops and manual retry machinery are removed; output repair becomes in-Agent bounded retry via retries={"output":N}
Provider fallback eligibility, tool surfaces, timeout/transport limits, provenance, and serialized output shapes remain unchanged from prior behavior
